newsitem.title: SPAIN: Key Spain rate may not track long rates -Rojo.
newsitem.headline: Key Spain rate may not track long rates -Rojo.

text.p: Bank of Spain Governor Luis Angel Rojo said on Tuesday that the official money market rate does not necessarily have to mirror long term rates.

"We mustn't expect that the Bank of Spain's basic intervention rate moves in strict parallel with longer term interest rates, nor that, in a period like the present characterised by sharp decreases in the latter, the reductions in long-term rates should be followed by more or less immediate cuts in the key intervention rate," Rojo said.
